name: liquid-gooey
title: Liquid Gooey
description: Liquid effects for real UI: touching pieces merge like goo, surfaces trail with a droplet tail, images melt together, with crisp content and real shadows.
label: Libraries.dev
author: Jakub Antalik <https://github.com/Jakubantalik>

props.name: Liquid blur
props.description: Goo blur sigma in px; neighbours merge once blur is about the gap between them.

props.name: Liquid contrast
props.description: Alpha-contrast slope: larger is a sharper liquid edge.

props.name: Liquid fill
props.description: The liquid surface color; any CSS color or variable.

props.name: Liquid shadow
props.description: box-shadow syntax, rendered on the merged silhouette (inset layers too).

props.name: Liquid.Item x / y / scale
props.description: Component-driven position: element and liquid move together.

props.name: Liquid.Item transition
props.description: How the item moves to x/y.

props.name: Liquid.Item effect
props.description: Merge and reshape, trail the element, melt two images together, or bow with velocity.

props.name: Liquid.Item dissolve
props.description: Melts imagery where surfaces touch (morph items).

a11y: Only the silhouette is filtered: content stays live DOM, so focus rings, hit targets, roles and labels are untouched.
Reduced motion: component-driven transitions snap to their end instead of animating.
The demo's satellite buttons are out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology while the menu is closed; the main button reports aria-expanded.
usage:
<Liquid blur={6} contrast={18} className="h-[140px] w-[200px]">
  <Liquid.Item x={open ? -54 : 0} y={open ? -34 : 0} transition="bouncy">
    <button type="button" aria-label="New file">…</button>
  </Liquid.Item>
</Liquid>
